verdicts.title: Quantized symplectic oscillator algebras of rank one
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: A quantized symplectic oscillator algebra of rank 1 is a PBW deformation of the smash product of the quantum plane with U_q(sl_2). We study its representation theory, and in particular, its category O.

verdicts.title: New Large-Rank Nichols Algebras Over Nonabelian Groups With Commutator Subgroup Z_2

verdicts.title: Applications of Monotone Rank to Complexity Theory
